scenarios.name: a child sees only their own piggy bank and transactions; an adult sees the whole family's, and a child cannot write

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_piggy_bank__piggy_banks (id, member_id, name, type, balance, created_at) VALUES ('pb_a', ?, 'A Savings', 'money', 500, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'), ('pb_b', ?, 'B Savings', 'money', 800, '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z')

INSERT INTO app_piggy_bank__transactions (id, bank_id, member_id, actor_id, amount, note, source, created_at) VALUES ('t_a', 'pb_a', ?, ?, 500, 'allowance', 'manual', '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z'), ('t_b', 'pb_b', ?, ?, 800, 'allowance', 'manual', '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z')
UPDATE app_piggy_bank__piggy_banks SET balance = 999999 WHERE id = 'pb_a'
